lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 vertical light-colored lines. The central four lines exhibit the highest contrast and are spaced roughly equidistant, while the peripheral lines are fainter and more irregular.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and sixth lines from the shoulder are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the dorsal ridge or ventral boundary.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature; horns diverge laterally from the frontal bone before curving medially and dorsally with a slight posterior inclination.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 0.12 of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white chevron-shaped band between the orbital regions and three distinct white pixel clusters (spots) on the lower cheek/mandible area.
